grains.RAW.ACCOUNTS: one row per fictional client account (delivery site city and client vertical)
grains.RAW.ACCOUNT_DAILY: one row per account per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.AGENT_CERTIFICATIONS: one row per account (agent certification coverage snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio-wide escalation FORECAST; repeat contact rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ESCALATION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic escalation handling SOPs (one per client vertical and escalation type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.PORTFOLIO_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.PORTFOLIO_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, account, escalation-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (accounts, daily escalations, SLA breaches by account, SLA breach risk, interaction events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_INTERACTIONS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_INTERACTION_ALERT logs new ESCALATED events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.breach_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(SLA breach for the account in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
